# Vendored Three.js r170

Official source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170

- build/three.module.js
- examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
- examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js
- examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js

All four JavaScript modules use local relative imports. This project does not
load these libraries from a CDN at runtime. The original MIT license is included
as LICENSE-three.txt. Model assets have their own attribution and terms; see
../models/README.md.
